712: def _validate_controller_pre_resume(startup, permit, session, worker):
713:     """Validate unpublished reserved pre-resume stage; never mint a worker witness.
714: 
715:     All four arguments are mandatory. Success reports the current locked local
716:     relation only, not observed native resume, assigned-job/read-set ownership,
717:     pipe provenance, completed child startup or permission to construct.
718:     """
719:     _require(type(startup) is _ControllerASRStart and type(session) is OwnedSession
720:              and worker is not None, "Exact startup, session and non-None worker required")
721:     custody = _CONTROLLER_STARTUPS.get(id(startup))
722:     _require(type(custody) is _StartupCustody and custody.startup is startup,
723:              "Copied controller startup has no issuance authority")
724:     with custody.manager._lock:
725:         with custody.token._lock:
726:             _validate_controller_pre_resume_locked(custody, startup, permit, session, worker)
727:     return startup

750: def _require_fixed_controller_functions(functions):
751:     current = (
752:         _capture_controller_boundary, _check_controller_entry, _check_controller_boundary,
753:         _require_fixed_controller_functions, _classify_controller_custody,
754:         _require_controller_binding, _validate_controller_pre_resume,
755:         _validate_controller_pre_resume_locked, _validate_controller_worker_stage,
756:         _validate_controller_worker_stage_locked, _validate_controller_startup,
757:         _validate_startup_locked, _startup_selection_current, _startup_references,
758:         _startup_values, _startup_authority_snapshot, _startup_configuration, _require,
759:         _STARTUP_PROFILE,
760:     )
761:     if (functions is not _CONTROLLER_BOUNDARY_FUNCTIONS or type(functions) is not tuple
762:             or len(functions) != len(current)
763:             or any(old is not now for old, now in zip(functions, current))):
764:         raise AdapterUnavailable("Fixed controller helper binding changed")

767: def _classify_controller_custody(profile, permit):
768:     # The current permit/record relation, never type spelling or field shape,
769:     # prevents an issued controller attempt from acquiring a generated fallback.
770:     _require(type(permit) is _NativePermit, "Exact controller classification permit required")
771:     is_controller = type(profile) is _ControllerASRStart
772:     if isinstance(profile, _ControllerASRStart) and not is_controller:
773:         raise AdapterUnavailable("Controller startup subclass refused")
774:     current = _CONTROLLER_STARTUPS.get(id(profile)) if is_controller else None
775:     matches = [c for c in _CONTROLLER_STARTUP_ATTEMPTS.values()
776:                if c.permit is permit or c.record is permit.record]
777:     if not is_controller and not matches:
778:         return None
779:     _require(is_controller and len(matches) == 1 and type(current) is _StartupCustody
780:              and matches[0] is current and current.startup is profile
781:              and current.permit is permit and current.record is permit.record
782:              and current.active and _CONTROLLER_STARTUP_ATTEMPTS.get(id(current)) is current,
783:              "Exact initially issued controller custody required")
784:     return current

787: def _capture_controller_boundary(profile, permit):
788:     functions = _CONTROLLER_BOUNDARY_FUNCTIONS
789:     if _require_fixed_controller_functions is not functions[3]:
790:         raise AdapterUnavailable("Fixed controller function guard changed")
791:     functions[3](functions)
792:     custody = functions[4](profile, permit)
793:     if custody is None:
794:         return None
795:     # Factory calls under manager then reservation locks, before owner issuance.
796:     functions[10](profile, permit)
797:     return _ControllerBoundary(custody, profile, permit, permit.identity, custody.factory,
798:         custody.manager, custody.record, custody.token, custody.lease, custody.protection,
799:         custody.references, custody.values, custody.initial_references, custody.initial_values,
800:         functions)

803: def _require_controller_binding(binding, startup, permit, session):
804:     if binding is None:
805:         # This is no authorization. The original generated delegate must still
806:         # accept its exact profile/sentinel/binding before doing any work.
807:         _require(_CONTROLLER_BOUNDARY_FUNCTIONS[4](startup, permit) is None,
808:                  "Generated start acquired conflicting controller custody")
809:         return None
810:     _require(type(binding) is _ControllerBoundary, "Exact captured controller binding required")
811:     custody = binding.custody
812:     _require(type(custody) is _StartupCustody and custody is _CONTROLLER_STARTUPS.get(id(startup))
813:              and _CONTROLLER_STARTUP_ATTEMPTS.get(id(custody)) is custody
814:              and binding.startup is startup and custody.startup is startup
815:              and binding.permit is permit and custody.permit is permit
816:              and permit.identity is binding.permit_identity
817:              and custody.factory is binding.factory and custody.manager is binding.manager
818:              and custody.record is binding.record and custody.token is binding.token
819:              and custody.lease is binding.lease and custody.protection is binding.protection
820:              and custody.references is binding.references and custody.values is binding.values
821:              and custody.initial_references is binding.initial_references
822:              and custody.initial_values is binding.initial_values
823:              and binding.functions is _CONTROLLER_BOUNDARY_FUNCTIONS
824:              and custody.active and type(session) is OwnedSession
825:              and session._manager is binding.manager and session._record is binding.record
826:              and binding.record.owner is session,
827:              "Original controller custody or binding changed")
828:     return custody

832:     functions = _CONTROLLER_BOUNDARY_FUNCTIONS if binding is None else binding.functions

845:     if _require_fixed_controller_functions is not functions[3]:

850:     custody = functions[5](binding, startup, permit, session)

853:             functions[6](startup, permit, session, worker)
854:         else:
855:             functions[8](startup, permit, session, worker, "finish_start")
